newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 16.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 16.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:
* The government is expected to announce new minimum regional wages later this month, with an average increase seen at around 10 percent.
* The Dow Jones industrial average ended 35.41 points lower at 6,726.88 on Wednesday, snapping a four-session streak of record closes in the absence of any significant economic news.
* The Jakarta Composite Index fell 0.59 points, or 0.09 percent, to close at 656.07 points on Wednesday after profit taking in Telkom and some medium-sized stocks.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,377.50/79.00 in early trading against the opening of 2,378.00/79.00.
* Property firm Jakarta International Hotels and Development on talk that the property firm was expected to list its subsidiary PT Danayasa Arthatama.
* Bank BNI on market talk the bank was likely to be included in the index computation of respected Morgan Stanley Capital International.
* Mayertex on renewed interest following an announcement of a tender offer.
* Distribution firm Enseval on market talk of a possible link-up with a foreign partner.
* Kalbe Farma on market talk that the firm planned to set up a joint distribution firm with a foreign partner, and planned to acquire a stake in a foreign firm.
* Trading firm Aneka Kimia Raya and chemical manufacturer Sorini on market talk of a possible cross holding between the two firms.
